needsResponse.body: Red Oaks: many fall programs begin the week of Sep 14. Registration closes Friday Sep 11 (some may fill earlier). Theatre, STEM, martial arts, athletics, band, and more. Middle School Basketball Team registration stays open through Oct 26.

scheduleNotes.title: First instructional day · Tue Sep 8
scheduleNotes.body: School calendar lists first day Tue Sep 8 (new PreK/K start Wed Sep 9). Thu Sep 3 orientation is Grade 5 and new students only.

scheduleNotes.title: Bus on delays and closures
scheduleNotes.body: 2-hour delay → 9:20am pickup. If SOMSD or Morris SD is closed, the Maplewood bus does not run even if Red Oaks is open.

needsResponse.title: Add PaySchools meal funds
needsResponse.body: Theo meal balance is still −$6.70 (below the $5 alert; another overnight alert Sep 3). Breakfast is 7:15am and costs $2.15. Add funds in PaySchools Central.

needsResponse.title: Check if 4SB welcome is Theo's class
needsResponse.body: BCC'd into a Bolden 4SB (4th grade) welcome from Sarah Benenati & Marisa Stoessel. Theo is listed as 3rd grade — confirm in PowerSchool. If he is in 4SB: join Remind (PDF in that email), introduce yourself with his name, PE Mon/Wed with sneakers, daily water bottle/snack/layers.

needsResponse.title: Confirm teacher assignment in PowerSchool
needsResponse.body: Posted Friday Aug 28. School is at capacity and will not honor class-change requests. Portal help: ParentPortalHelp@somsd.k12.nj.us.

upcoming.title: Coffee with Calissi
upcoming.body: Listed on the Bolden PTA calendar at 7:50am. No extra details in district mail.

upcoming.title: Back-to-School Night
upcoming.body: 6:30pm. That day is a 4-hour day for students; dismissal 11:50am.

scheduleNotes.title: South Orange roadwork near Bolden
scheduleNotes.body: Sep 2 Bolden mail from Mr. Calissi: village roadwork may affect transportation routes and cause delays. NJ American Water is not planning lead-line replacement this week or next. Details: https://www.southorange.org/m/newsflash/home/detail/2587

scheduleNotes.title: Daily hours
scheduleNotes.body: 7:50am–2:20pm; do not arrive before 7:40am. 3rd grade lines up in the gym. Car drop-off: Maryland Road only 7:30–8:00am. Breakfast 7:15am, $2.15, rear door off the parking lot. Dismissal 2:20pm, front lawn facing Ridgewood Road. Virginia Road closed to through traffic 2:00–2:30pm.

scheduleNotes.title: Wed Sep 23 early dismissal
scheduleNotes.body: Back-to-School Night evening. Students dismiss at 11:50am (4-hour day).
